base_url.label: Base URL
base_url.description: Address of your Mastodon server. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

access_token.label: Access Token
access_token.description: Created under Preferences > Development; see the steps above.

get_status.label: Get Status
get_status.description: Get a single status by its ID.

status_id.label: Status ID
status_id.description: ID of the status, for example from a trigger or Search.

delete_status.label: Delete Status
delete_status.description: Permanently delete one of your own statuses.

status_id.label: Status ID
status_id.description: ID of one of your own statuses, for example from Post Status.

delete_media.label: Delete Media Now
delete_media.description: Remove attached media now, not after about 24 hours. Mastodon 4.4+.

get_status_context.label: Get Status Thread
get_status_context.description: Get the ancestors and replies of a status.

status_id.label: Status ID
status_id.description: Local ID of the status whose thread to read. Obtain it from a timeline, Get Status or Search.

favourite_status.label: Favourite Status
favourite_status.description: Add a status to your favourites.

status_id.label: Status ID
status_id.description: ID of the status, for example from a trigger, Get Status or Search.

unfavourite_status.label: Unfavourite Status
unfavourite_status.description: Remove a status from your favourites.

status_id.label: Status ID
status_id.description: Local ID of the status on this server, for example 109372843234737004. Obtain it from a timeline, Get Status or Search (use resolve for a status URL from another server).

boost_status.label: Boost Status
boost_status.description: Share a status with your followers by boosting it.

status_id.label: Status ID
status_id.description: ID of the status, for example from a trigger, Get Status or Search.

visibility.label: Visibility
visibility.description: Who sees the boost. Empty uses your account default.

unboost_status.label: Unboost Status
unboost_status.description: Undo a boost (reblog) of a status.

status_id.label: Status ID
status_id.description: Local ID of the status on this server, for example 109372843234737004. Obtain it from a timeline, Get Status or Search (use resolve for a status URL from another server).

status_id.label: Status ID
status_id.description: Local ID of the status on this server, for example 109372843234737004. Obtain it from a timeline, Get Status or Search (use resolve for a status URL from another server).

unbookmark_status.label: Remove Bookmark
unbookmark_status.description: Remove a status from your bookmarks.

status_id.label: Status ID
status_id.description: Local ID of the status on this server, for example 109372843234737004. Obtain it from a timeline, Get Status or Search (use resolve for a status URL from another server).

mute_conversation.label: Mute Conversation
mute_conversation.description: Stop receiving notifications for a thread.

status_id.label: Status ID
status_id.description: Local ID of the status on this server, for example 109372843234737004. Obtain it from a timeline, Get Status or Search (use resolve for a status URL from another server).

unmute_conversation.label: Unmute Conversation
unmute_conversation.description: Resume notifications for a muted thread.

status_id.label: Status ID
status_id.description: Local ID of the status on this server, for example 109372843234737004. Obtain it from a timeline, Get Status or Search (use resolve for a status URL from another server).

pin_status.label: Pin Status to Profile
pin_status.description: Feature one of your statuses at the top of your profile.

status_id.label: Status ID
status_id.description: Local ID of your own status. Obtain it from Create Status, Get Status or List Account Statuses.

unpin_status.label: Unpin Status from Profile
unpin_status.description: Remove a pinned status from your profile.

status_id.label: Status ID
status_id.description: Local ID of your own status. Obtain it from Create Status, Get Status or List Account Statuses.

get_scheduled_status.label: Get Scheduled Status
get_scheduled_status.description: Get a scheduled status by its ID.

scheduled_status_id.label: Scheduled Status ID
scheduled_status_id.description: ID of the scheduled status. Obtain it from Schedule Status or List Scheduled Statuses.

update_media.label: Update Media
update_media.description: Change the alt text or focal point of an uploaded media file.

media_id.label: Media ID
media_id.description: ID of the unattached media. Obtain it from Upload Media.

description.label: Alt Text
description.description: New plain-text description of the media for accessibility.

focus.label: Focal Point
focus.description: New focal point as two comma-separated numbers from -1.0 to 1.0, for example 0.0,0.5.

get_my_account.label: Get My Account
get_my_account.description: Get the profile of the connected account.

update_my_profile.label: Update My Profile
update_my_profile.description: Update the display name, bio and settings of the connected account.

display_name.label: Display Name
display_name.description: New display name shown on the profile. Leave empty to keep the current display name.

note.label: Bio
note.description: New profile bio text. Leave empty to keep the current bio.

locked.label: Require Follow Approval
locked.description: Whether new followers must be approved manually. Leave empty to keep the current setting.

bot.label: Bot Account
bot.description: Whether the profile is flagged as an automated (bot) account. Leave empty to keep the current setting.

discoverable.label: Discoverable
discoverable.description: Whether the account is featured in the profile directory. Leave empty to keep the current setting.

default_visibility.label: Default Post Visibility
default_visibility.description: Default privacy for new posts. Leave empty to keep the current setting.

default_language.label: Default Post Language
default_language.description: Default ISO 639-1 language code for new posts, for example en.

get_account.label: Get Account
get_account.description: Get a Mastodon account profile by its ID.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: Local ID of the account on this server, for example 109302436954721982. Obtain it from Lookup Account, Search Accounts, Get Account or Search (use resolve for a remote user@domain).

lookup_account.label: Lookup Account
lookup_account.description: Find an account by its handle to get its Account ID.

acct.label: Handle
acct.description: A username on your server, or user@domain for another server.

follow_account.label: Follow Account
follow_account.description: Follow an account, or send a follow request to a locked account.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: ID of the account, for example from Lookup Account or New Follower.

reblogs.label: Show Their Boosts
reblogs.description: Show their boosts in your home timeline. Empty means yes.

notify.label: Notify When They Post
notify.description: Get a notification for each of their statuses. Empty means no.

languages.label: Languages
languages.description: Only show their statuses in these language codes. Empty shows all.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: ID of the account, for example from Lookup Account or New Follower.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: Local ID of the account on this server, for example 109302436954721982. Obtain it from Lookup Account, Search Accounts, Get Account or Search (use resolve for a remote user@domain).

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: Local ID of the account on this server, for example 109302436954721982. Obtain it from Lookup Account, Search Accounts, Get Account or Search (use resolve for a remote user@domain).

mute_account.label: Mute Account
mute_account.description: Hide an account's posts, and optionally its notifications.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: Local ID of the account to mute. Obtain it from Lookup Account, Search Accounts or Search (use resolve for a remote user@domain).

notifications.label: Mute Notifications
notifications.description: Also hide notifications from this account. Leave empty for the default (yes).

duration.label: Duration (seconds)
duration.description: How long the mute lasts, in seconds, for example 86400 for one day. Leave empty or 0 to mute indefinitely.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: Local ID of the account on this server, for example 109302436954721982. Obtain it from Lookup Account, Search Accounts, Get Account or Search (use resolve for a remote user@domain).

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: Local ID of the account that requested to follow you. Obtain it from List Follow Requests.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: Local ID of the account that requested to follow you. Obtain it from List Follow Requests.

get_notification.label: Get Notification
get_notification.description: Get a single notification by its ID.

notification_id.label: Notification ID
notification_id.description: ID of the notification. Obtain it from List Notifications.

get_unread_notification_count.label: Get Unread Notification Count
get_unread_notification_count.description: Get the number of unread notifications.

types.label: Count Only Types
types.description: Only count these notification types. Leave empty for all types.

options.label: New post from an account you enabled notifications for

exclude_types.label: Exclude Types
exclude_types.description: Do not count these notification types.

options.label: New post from an account you enabled notifications for

account_id.label: From Account ID
account_id.description: Only count notifications caused by this account (local account ID).

limit.label: Maximum Count
limit.description: Stop counting at this number. Defaults to 100, maximum 1000.

search.label: Search
search.description: Search for accounts, statuses and hashtags.

q.label: Query
q.description: Text, a #hashtag, a user@domain handle or a status URL.

resolve.label: Resolve Remote Content
resolve.description: Fetch results from other servers. Empty: on for URLs and user@domain.

following.label: Only Accounts I Follow
following.description: Limits account results to accounts you follow.

account_id.label: Statuses by Account ID
account_id.description: Only statuses written by this account.

exclude_unreviewed.label: Exclude Unreviewed Hashtags
exclude_unreviewed.description: Skip hashtags your server's moderators have not reviewed.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum results of each type per page, up to 40.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Results to skip. Works only when Result Type is set.

max_id.label: Max ID
max_id.description: Only results older than this ID.

min_id.label: Min ID
min_id.description: Only results just newer than this ID.

get_list.label: Get List
get_list.description: Get one of your lists by its ID.

list_id.label: List ID
list_id.description: ID of one of your lists. Obtain it from List Lists or Create List.

create_list.label: Create List
create_list.description: Create a new list for grouping accounts you follow.

title.label: Title
title.description: Name of the list, for example News.

replies_policy.label: Show Replies To
replies_policy.description: Which replies appear in the list timeline. Leave empty for the default (list members).

exclusive.label: Hide Members From Home Timeline
exclusive.description: Whether posts from list members are removed from the home timeline. Leave empty for the default (no).

update_list.label: Update List
update_list.description: Rename a list or change its settings.

list_id.label: List ID
list_id.description: ID of one of your lists. Obtain it from List Lists or Create List.

title.label: Title
title.description: New name of the list. Leave empty to keep the current title.

replies_policy.label: Show Replies To
replies_policy.description: Which replies appear in the list timeline. Leave empty to keep the current setting.

exclusive.label: Hide Members From Home Timeline
exclusive.description: Whether posts from list members are removed from the home timeline. Leave empty to keep the current setting.

get_poll.label: Get Poll
get_poll.description: Get a poll with its current results.

poll_id.label: Poll ID
poll_id.description: ID of the poll (the poll.id field of a status). Obtain it from Get Status or a timeline.

mark_conversation_read.label: Mark Conversation as Read
mark_conversation_read.description: Mark a direct-message conversation as read.

conversation_id.label: Conversation ID
conversation_id.description: ID of the direct-message conversation. Obtain it from List Conversations.

tag_name.label: Hashtag
tag_name.description: Hashtag name without the # sign, for example mastodon. A leading # is removed automatically.

follow_tag.label: Follow Hashtag
follow_tag.description: Follow a hashtag so its posts appear in your home timeline.

tag_name.label: Hashtag
tag_name.description: Hashtag name without the # sign, for example mastodon. A leading # is removed automatically.

tag_name.label: Hashtag
tag_name.description: Hashtag name without the # sign, for example mastodon. A leading # is removed automatically.

get_filter.label: Get Filter
get_filter.description: Get one of your content filters by its ID.

filter_id.label: Filter ID
filter_id.description: ID of the filter. Obtain it from List Filters or Create Filter.

update_filter.label: Update Filter
update_filter.description: Change the title, contexts, action or expiry of a content filter.

filter_id.label: Filter ID
filter_id.description: ID of the filter. Obtain it from List Filters or Create Filter.

title.label: Title
title.description: New name of the filter. Leave empty to keep the current title.

context.label: Apply In
context.description: Replaces where the filter applies. Leave empty to keep the current contexts.

filter_action.label: Action
filter_action.description: What happens to matching posts. Leave empty to keep the current action.

expires_in.label: Expires In (seconds)
expires_in.description: New expiry, in seconds from now. Leave empty to keep the current expiry.

get_instance_info.label: Get Instance Info
get_instance_info.description: Get information about the connected Mastodon server.
